mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate for equity cash flows, leading to higher valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the direction of the relationship reverses (negative IC) in more than 40% of 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, the market anticipates monetary policy easing, which boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.0%, the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a falling federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals an active monetary easing cycle in response to labor market weakness, which strongly supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) fails to produce a positive Rank IC above 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window, or the 60-day forward returns in the triggered regime are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST < 480.0) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, when HOUST < 480.0, the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly job growth (PAYEMS increasing) indicates a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or the direction of the relationship reverses (negative IC) in more than 40% of 1-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When annual inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY) exceeds 2.5%, the market anticipates Federal Reserve tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 480.0) and industrial production (INDPRO < 94.0) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * INDPRO) fails to produce a negative Rank IC below -0.03 in any 2-year rolling window, or the 20-day forward returns in the triggered regime are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In the post-shock recovery regime, a rebound in industrial production (INDPRO > 95.0) signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-shock recovery regime, when INDPRO > 95.0, the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
